    The input did not match the regular expression /double-progression logic/. Input:
    
    '=== DETERMINISTIC PROGRAM SKELETON, DO NOT DELETE REQUIRED EXPOSURES ===\n' +

      'Hard session cap: 60 minutes INCLUDING warm-up, rests, transitions and any Zone 2 placed inside the session.\n' +
      'Required coaching constraints:\n' +
      '* DUAL BOX-SQUAT GOAL: the high-rep target and max target are different outcomes and require different exposures.\n' +
      '* BOX_SQUAT_HEAVY: one max-strength exposure each week, normally 1-4 reps per set, long rest, no grinding; this serves the 1RM/max side.\n' +
      '* BOX_SQUAT_REP: separate rep-strength exposure for the 10-rep outcome. Start with repeatable 6-8 rep work and progress toward 8-10 quality reps. Speed doubles/triples do not count.\n' +
      '* Rep-strength progression is primarily double progression: earn clean reps inside the RPE window, then add 2.5-5 kg and rebuild reps. The distant 180 kg x 10 target is NOT the Week 1 working load.\n' +
      '* Current tolerated box-squat max anchor is about 210 kg. Initial 6-8 rep work should usually sit around 150-167.5 kg at RPE 7-8; 2-4 rep max-strength work around 172.5-190 kg at roughly RPE 7.5-8.5. Adjust from observed RPE, never from the future target.\n' +
      '* OAP LEVEL: athlete already owns 2 strict One-Arm Pull-up reps. Program from demonstrated advanced level.\n' +
      '* OAP exposure A: strict One-Arm Pull-up singles/clusters, multiple high-quality singles per arm, normally at least 1 rep from technical failure.\n' +
      '* OAP exposure B: Assisted One-Arm Pull-up doubles/triples with the minimum assistance needed for clean symmetrical reps. Progress by less assistance or more clean reps.\n' +
      '* STRICT OHP IS A PROGRESSION GOAL, not maintenance. Use two meaningful strict Overhead Press exposures on separate days.\n' +
      '* OHP exposure A: strength-biased strict Overhead Press, usually 3-5 reps per set around RPE 7.5-8.5.\n' +
      '* OHP exposure B: volume/technique strict Overhead Press, usually 5-8 reps per set around RPE 6.5-8. Push Press is optional overload and does not replace both strict exposures.\n' +
      '* Current strict OHP anchor is 75 kg x about 4+ reps; prescribe from CURRENT performance, not historical PR or target.\n' +
      '* Long-term strict OHP target is about 75 kg; use repeatable submaximal progression, not token maintenance or weekly grinders.\n' +
      '* Two meaningful low-fatigue Zone 2 exposures using canonical Zone-2 Bike or Zone-2 Row, roughly 20-35 minutes each. A 10-12 minute mini-dose does not satisfy this aerobic-base goal.\n' +
      '* Retain direct Cable Lateral Raise at minimum useful dose.\n' +
      '* Retain Face Pull at minimum useful dose.\n' +
      '* Retain one or two very low-volume explosive primers. Use verified canonical Box Jump or Broad Jump unless another exact verified movement exists. Place after warm-up and before heavy strength; stop before velocity loss.\n' +
      '* ALL 4 listed gym days are genuine strength/full-body sessions. Zone 2 may be appended/separate, but no gym day may be cardio-only. Every gym day needs real strength or advanced-skill work; with full-body preference it should normally include meaningful upper and lower/support work when recovery allows.\n' +
      'Preferred/support choices:\n' +
      '* Weighted Chin-up may support OAP once weekly but never replace unilateral specificity. With current +80 kg external-load 1RM, an initial 4-6 rep support range around +45 to +57.5 kg is plausible, autoregulated by RPE and elbow/grip freshness.\n' +
      '* Use explicitly tolerated Box Squat to Parallel instead of forcing deeper ROM.\n' +
      '* Hip Thrust or Glute Bridge is preferred low-spinal-fatigue posterior-chain assistance.\n' +
      'Forbidden/tolerance-gated choices:\n' +
      '* One-Arm Pull-up Eccentric/negative as either main OAP exposure for an athlete already owning 2+ strict reps.\n' +
      '* Archer Pull-up or generic bilateral pulling as a substitute for either required unilateral OAP exposure.\n' +
      '* Freestanding HSPU volume that steals recovery/session time from strict OHP when HSPU is explicitly nice-to-have.\n' +
      '* Unrequested hard intervals, threshold, VO2, AMRAP, sprints or hard running when combat sport already supplies high-intensity conditioning.\n' +
      '* Deep loaded squatting that reproduces lumbar-flexion symptoms.\n' +
      '* Heavy Romanian Deadlift, Good Morning or Back Extension unless tolerance is explicitly established and the row states a tolerance gate.\n' +

      '* SPECIALIST SOURCE: Advanced Gymnastics / skill graph family=one_arm_pull_up.\n' +
      '* Universal skill rule: direct exposure to the actual skill family remains the anchor once the athlete can perform a measurable tolerated version. Assistance supports specificity; it does not replace it. Quality stops the set before technically poor attempts accumulate.\n' +
      '* Anti-hallucination rule: prescribe only complete named variations that exist in the verified skill graph/exercise library. Never invent a banded, wall, eccentric, partial, one-leg, tuck or deficit variation by wording alone.\n' +
      '* Ordering rule: primary skill work is performed after warm-up and any genuinely non-fatiguing primer, before fatigue-producing strength/hypertrophy work.\n' +
      '* DETERMINISTIC SKILL-GRAPH SELECTION: {"gated":true,"rungIndex":0,"rung":{"name":"Weighted Pull-Up","criterion":{"type":"benchmark","metric":"weighted_pullup_bw_pct","min":50},"dose":{"sets":5,"reps":"3-5","rest":"3 min","rir":"1","frequency_per_week":2},"complementary":["Scapular Pull-up"]},"demonstratedIndex":-1,"missing":["12+ strict pull-ups","weighted pull-up at BW+30%"],"reason":"Prerequisite gate for One-Arm Pull-Up not met — 12+ strict pull-ups; weighted pull-up at BW+30%"}.     === DETERMINISTIC PROGRAM SKELETON, DO NOT DELETE REQUIRED EXPOSURES ===
    Gym days (4): Wed, Fri, Sat, Sun.
    Hard session cap: 60 minutes INCLUDING warm-up, rests, transitions and any Zone 2 placed inside the session.
    Required coaching constraints:
    * DUAL BOX-SQUAT GOAL: the high-rep target and max target are different outcomes and require different exposures.
    * BOX_SQUAT_HEAVY: one max-strength exposure each week, normally 1-4 reps per set, long rest, no grinding; this serves the 1RM/max side.
    * BOX_SQUAT_REP: separate rep-strength exposure for the 10-rep outcome. Start with repeatable 6-8 rep work and progress toward 8-10 quality reps. Speed doubles/triples do not count.
    * Rep-strength progression is primarily double progression: earn clean reps inside the RPE window, then add 2.5-5 kg and rebuild reps. The distant 180 kg x 10 target is NOT the Week 1 working load.
    * Current tolerated box-squat max anchor is about 210 kg. Initial 6-8 rep work should usually sit around 150-167.5 kg at RPE 7-8; 2-4 rep max-strength work around 172.5-190 kg at roughly RPE 7.5-8.5. Adjust from observed RPE, never from the future target.
    * OAP LEVEL: athlete already owns 2 strict One-Arm Pull-up reps. Program from demonstrated advanced level.
    * OAP exposure A: strict One-Arm Pull-up singles/clusters, multiple high-quality singles per arm, normally at least 1 rep from technical failure.
    * OAP exposure B: Assisted One-Arm Pull-up doubles/triples with the minimum assistance needed for clean symmetrical reps. Progress by less assistance or more clean reps.
    * STRICT OHP IS A PROGRESSION GOAL, not maintenance. Use two meaningful strict Overhead Press exposures on separate days.
    * OHP exposure A: strength-biased strict Overhead Press, usually 3-5 reps per set around RPE 7.5-8.5.
    * OHP exposure B: volume/technique strict Overhead Press, usually 5-8 reps per set around RPE 6.5-8. Push Press is optional overload and does not replace both strict exposures.
    * Current strict OHP anchor is 75 kg x about 4+ reps; prescribe from CURRENT performance, not historical PR or target.
    * Long-term strict OHP target is about 75 kg; use repeatable submaximal progression, not token maintenance or weekly grinders.
    * Two meaningful low-fatigue Zone 2 exposures using canonical Zone-2 Bike or Zone-2 Row, roughly 20-35 minutes each. A 10-12 minute mini-dose does not satisfy this aerobic-base goal.
    * Retain direct Cable Lateral Raise at minimum useful dose.
    * Retain Face Pull at minimum useful dose.
    * Retain one or two very low-volume explosive primers. Use verified canonical Box Jump or Broad Jump unless another exact verified movement exists. Place after warm-up and before heavy strength; stop before velocity loss.
    * ALL 4 listed gym days are genuine strength/full-body sessions. Zone 2 may be appended/separate, but no gym day may be cardio-only. Every gym day needs real strength or advanced-skill work; with full-body preference it should normally include meaningful upper and lower/support work when recovery allows.
    Preferred/support choices:
    * Weighted Chin-up may support OAP once weekly but never replace unilateral specificity. With current +80 kg external-load 1RM, an initial 4-6 rep support range around +45 to +57.5 kg is plausible, autoregulated by RPE and elbow/grip freshness.
    * Use explicitly tolerated Box Squat to Parallel instead of forcing deeper ROM.
    * Hip Thrust or Glute Bridge is preferred low-spinal-fatigue posterior-chain assistance.
    Forbidden/tolerance-gated choices:
    * One-Arm Pull-up Eccentric/negative as either main OAP exposure for an athlete already owning 2+ strict reps.
    * Archer Pull-up or generic bilateral pulling as a substitute for either required unilateral OAP exposure.
    * Freestanding HSPU volume that steals recovery/session time from strict OHP when HSPU is explicitly nice-to-have.
    * Unrequested hard intervals, threshold, VO2, AMRAP, sprints or hard running when combat sport already supplies high-intensity conditioning.
    * Deep loaded squatting that reproduces lumbar-flexion symptoms.
    * Heavy Romanian Deadlift, Good Morning or Back Extension unless tolerance is explicitly established and the row states a tolerance gate.
    === GOAL-SPECIFIC SPECIALIST RULES ===
    * SPECIALIST SOURCE: Advanced Gymnastics / skill graph family=one_arm_pull_up.
    * Universal skill rule: direct exposure to the actual skill family remains the anchor once the athlete can perform a measurable tolerated version. Assistance supports specificity; it does not replace it. Quality stops the set before technically poor attempts accumulate.
    * Anti-hallucination rule: prescribe only complete named variations that exist in the verified skill graph/exercise library. Never invent a banded, wall, eccentric, partial, one-leg, tuck or deficit variation by wording alone.
    * Ordering rule: primary skill work is performed after warm-up and any genuinely non-fatiguing primer, before fatigue-producing strength/hypertrophy work.
    * DETERMINISTIC SKILL-GRAPH SELECTION: {"gated":true,"rungIndex":0,"rung":{"name":"Weighted Pull-Up","criterion":{"type":"benchmark","metric":"weighted_pullup_bw_pct","min":50},"dose":{"sets":5,"reps":"3-5","rest":"3 min","rir":"1","frequency_per_week":2},"complementary":["Scapular Pull-up"]},"demonstratedIndex":-1,"missing":["12+ strict pull-ups","weighted pull-up at BW+30%"],"reason":"Prerequisite gate for One-Arm Pull-Up not met — 12+ strict pull-ups; weighted pull-up at BW+30%"}.     === DETERMINISTIC PROGRAM SKELETON, DO NOT DELETE REQUIRED EXPOSURES ===
    Gym days (4): Wed, Fri, Sat, Sun.
    Hard session cap: 60 minutes INCLUDING warm-up, rests, transitions and any Zone 2 placed inside the session.
    Required coaching constraints:
    * DUAL BOX-SQUAT GOAL: the high-rep target and max target are different outcomes and require different exposures.
    * BOX_SQUAT_HEAVY: one max-strength exposure each week, normally 1-4 reps per set, long rest, no grinding; this serves the 1RM/max side.
    * BOX_SQUAT_REP: separate rep-strength exposure for the 10-rep outcome. Start with repeatable 6-8 rep work and progress toward 8-10 quality reps. Speed doubles/triples do not count.
    * Rep-strength progression is primarily double progression: earn clean reps inside the RPE window, then add 2.5-5 kg and rebuild reps. The distant 180 kg x 10 target is NOT the Week 1 working load.
    * Current tolerated box-squat max anchor is about 210 kg. Initial 6-8 rep work should usually sit around 150-167.5 kg at RPE 7-8; 2-4 rep max-strength work around 172.5-190 kg at roughly RPE 7.5-8.5. Adjust from observed RPE, never from the future target.
    * OAP LEVEL: athlete already owns 2 strict One-Arm Pull-up reps. Program from demonstrated advanced level.
    * OAP exposure A: strict One-Arm Pull-up singles/clusters, multiple high-quality singles per arm, normally at least 1 rep from technical failure.
    * OAP exposure B: Assisted One-Arm Pull-up doubles/triples with the minimum assistance needed for clean symmetrical reps. Progress by less assistance or more clean reps.
    * STRICT OHP IS A PROGRESSION GOAL, not maintenance. Use two meaningful strict Overhead Press exposures on separate days.
    * OHP exposure A: strength-biased strict Overhead Press, usually 3-5 reps per set around RPE 7.5-8.5.
    * OHP exposure B: volume/technique strict Overhead Press, usually 5-8 reps per set around RPE 6.5-8. Push Press is optional overload and does not replace both strict exposures.
    * Current strict OHP anchor is 75 kg x about 4+ reps; prescribe from CURRENT performance, not historical PR or target.
    * Long-term strict OHP target is about 75 kg; use repeatable submaximal progression, not token maintenance or weekly grinders.
    * Two meaningful low-fatigue Zone 2 exposures using canonical Zone-2 Bike or Zone-2 Row, roughly 20-35 minutes each. A 10-12 minute mini-dose does not satisfy this aerobic-base goal.
    * Retain direct Cable Lateral Raise at minimum useful dose.
    * Retain Face Pull at minimum useful dose.
    * Retain one or two very low-volume explosive primers. Use verified canonical Box Jump or Broad Jump unless another exact verified movement exists. Place after warm-up and before heavy strength; stop before velocity loss.
    * ALL 4 listed gym days are genuine strength/full-body sessions. Zone 2 may be appended/separate, but no gym day may be cardio-only. Every gym day needs real strength or advanced-skill work; with full-body preference it should normally include meaningful upper and lower/support work when recovery allows.
    Preferred/support choices:
    * Weighted Chin-up may support OAP once weekly but never replace unilateral specificity. With current +80 kg external-load 1RM, an initial 4-6 rep support range around +45 to +57.5 kg is plausible, autoregulated by RPE and elbow/grip freshness.
    * Use explicitly tolerated Box Squat to Parallel instead of forcing deeper ROM.
    * Hip Thrust or Glute Bridge is preferred low-spinal-fatigue posterior-chain assistance.
    Forbidden/tolerance-gated choices:
    * One-Arm Pull-up Eccentric/negative as either main OAP exposure for an athlete already owning 2+ strict reps.
    * Archer Pull-up or generic bilateral pulling as a substitute for either required unilateral OAP exposure.
    * Freestanding HSPU volume that steals recovery/session time from strict OHP when HSPU is explicitly nice-to-have.
    * Unrequested hard intervals, threshold, VO2, AMRAP, sprints or hard running when combat sport already supplies high-intensity conditioning.
    * Deep loaded squatting that reproduces lumbar-flexion symptoms.
    * Heavy Romanian Deadlift, Good Morning or Back Extension unless tolerance is explicitly established and the row states a tolerance gate.
    === GOAL-SPECIFIC SPECIALIST RULES ===
